purpose: Calibration session template for the P1 physical print-and-photograph experiment. Fill every FILL-IN field before capture; the completed manifest becomes the calibration_profile stage evidence referenced by the session ExperimentArtifact.

target.print_note: Print at 100% scale on the same printer/substrate profile used for garments; verify the 100 mm scale bar with a ruler before use.

settings.white_balance: FILL-IN: fixed Kelvin, no auto WB

lighting.positions_mm: FILL-IN: (x, y, z) per fixture relative to garment plane origin
lighting.ambient_control: windowless room or blackout; ambient lux at garment plane FILL-IN

capture_angles.calibration_capture: single perpendicular (0 deg yaw, 0 deg pitch) capture of the full target at the session camera distance

patch_measurement_procedure: 1. Photograph the calibration target under the locked session rig before any garment capture and after the last garment capture (bracketing).
2. Locate the four fiducials; compute the homography to the manifest fiducial coordinates (mm).
3. Rectify the capture; verify each fiducial against its nominal mm coordinate (registration error, mm).
4. Verify the scale bar: measured px per mm against the manifest 100 mm length (scale error, %).
5. Sample each patch centre (inner 50% of the patch) and convert sRGB to CIELAB D65/2.
6. Record PatchMeasurement / ScaleMeasurement / RegistrationMeasurement objects and build a PrintCameraProfile (ruthless_pipeline.certification.calibration_ingest).
7. Evaluate PrintCameraProfile.acceptance(); a session may start only if it passes. Re-run after the final garment capture; drift failure invalidates the session.
evidence_labels_note: Completed profiles are internally_measured; they become RAC-P evidence only when bound into a session whose ExperimentArtifact carries the physical_session stage.
